Residency : Mark Wastell : Duo Intern – with Charlotte Keeffe. Saturday 31st October 16:00

Posted on September 18, 2026 by HundredYearsGallery

Each month, Mark Wastell invites a different performer to join him in creating something unique, between 4.30-5.30pm, while the gallery remains open and goes about its normal activity. This months guest is Charlotte Keeffe.

Charlotte Keeffe : trumpet / flugelhorn
Mark Wastell : percussion

Doors 4pm | Free event. Spectators welcome.
